Built with a durable cabinet and built-in woofer and driver system, it ensures deep bass and immersive sound for your home audio setup. This bluetooth home theatre speaker offers multiple connectivity options including Bluetooth 5.0 for wireless streaming, along with USB, SD card, AUX input, and FM radio. It easily connects to TV, mobile, laptop, and other devices, making it a complete multimedia speaker and home audio speaker system for all your entertainment needs. The built-in 5mm microphone input allows use as a karaoke speaker, perfect for singing, announcements, and gatherings. The LED display helps with FM tuning and playback control, while the RGB lights add a modern touch, making it a stylish RGB speaker for your home.
